feed.title: HeatWatch
feed.subtitle: Where heat is breaking records, who it is reaching, what the rules are about to require, and what can be done about it.

entry.title: Fitzroy Crossing, Western Australia, reached 47.1 °C on 4 November, reported as a November record
entry.summary: Australia's Bureau of Meteorology measured 43 to 47.1 °C at Fitzroy Crossing every day from 1 to 6 November, with nights of 26 to 29 °C. Marble Bar reached 46.5 °C and Port Hedland 44.3 °C. — Sources: Australian Bureau of Meteorology, daily weather observations, Fitzroy Crossing, Marble Bar and Port Hedland, November 2026 · Weatherzone, 5 November 2026 · Australian Bureau of Meteorology, Western Australia heatwave warning, 7 November 2026

entry.title: Queensland's heatwave warning was raised to Extreme on 7 November after Mount Isa spent five days at or above 40 °C
entry.summary: Mount Isa recorded 40.2 to 41.6 °C from 1 to 5 November and Julia Creek 42.2 °C. Queensland's warning now runs to 10 November. The Northern Territory has an Extreme warning for Tiwi. — Sources: Australian Bureau of Meteorology, Queensland heatwave warning IDQ21013, issued 7 November 2026 · Australian Bureau of Meteorology, daily weather observations, Mount Isa and Julia Creek, November 2026 · Australian Bureau of Meteorology, Northern Territory heatwave warning, 7 November 2026

entry.title: Vietnam had its hottest October on record, with 61 stations equalling or breaking daily maximum records
entry.summary: Vietnam's weather service reports that 61 stations equalled or broke daily maximum records in October and 98 broke October mean records. — Sources: VTC News and CafeF, citing Vietnam's National Centre for Hydro-Meteorological Forecasting, 2 November 2026

entry.title: Australia's weekly El Niño ocean index reached +2.88 °C for the week to 1 November, its highest weekly value
entry.summary: Australia's Bureau of Meteorology data give a relative Niño3.4 of +2.88 °C for 26 October to 1 November. — Sources: Australian Bureau of Meteorology, weekly relative Niño3.4 data, read 7 November 2026 · Instituto Nacional de Meteorologia, Brazil, 3 November 2026 · ENFEN, Peru, official communique of 30 October 2026, via Gestión, 31 October 2026

entry.title: Peru ran a red heat alert for up to 38 °C across 17 departments to 4 November
entry.summary: Peru's weather service Senamhi issued a red-level alert for maximum temperatures up to 38 °C on the coast and in the highlands, covering Lima, Piura, Tumbes, La Libertad, Lambayeque, Ica and Arequipa among 17 departments. — Sources: Senamhi, Aviso 447, via El Peruano, 2 November 2026 · ENFEN, Peru, official communique of 30 October 2026, via Gestión, 31 October 2026

entry.title: Heat and drought in Brazil's MATOPIBA farm belt are slowing soy planting
entry.summary: Brazil's weather service reports October maximum temperatures 2 to 3 °C above normal across MATOPIBA, with Araguaína 3.2 °C above. — Sources: Instituto Nacional de Meteorologia, Brazil, 4 and 5 November 2026

entry.title: The Rhine at Kaub, Germany, stayed between 16 and 25 centimetres all week
entry.summary: Germany's federal gauge network read 25 cm at Kaub on 1 November, 16 cm on 2 to 3 November and 21 cm on 7 November. The river needs about 77 cm on the gauge for its standard fairway depth. — Sources: Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung, Pegelonline gauge network, Kaub, 31 October to 7 November 2026

entry.title: England's reservoirs reached 60.1 percent, and severe drought continues in the south west and Sussex
entry.summary: The Environment Agency reports a very dry week to 5 November, with 2 mm of rain and river flows falling everywhere. Storage rose to 60.1 percent, 17 percent below average. — Sources: Environment Agency, Dry weather and drought in England, 30 October to 5 November 2026, published 6 November 2026

entry.title: Indonesia's haze reached the hazardous band in Central Kalimantan on 3 November as underground peat fires persist
entry.summary: Indonesia's government reported PM2.5 in the hazardous band at Kotawaringin Timur and Palangka Raya on 3 November, with 15 more districts unhealthy. High-confidence hotspots fell to 96 on 1 November. — Sources: InfoPublik, Government of Indonesia, 4 November 2026 · Bernama via The Star, 1 November 2026

entry.title: Singapore's haze eased to a 24-hour PSI of 52 to 55 on 7 November
entry.summary: Singapore's 24-hour PSI fell from 70 to 89 on 1 November to 52 to 55 at 1pm on 7 November, at the low end of the moderate band in all five regions. — Sources: National Environment Agency, Singapore, hourly 24-hour PSI data, 1 to 7 November 2026

entry.title: Queensland, Australia had 58 fires burning on 7 November, none at Watch and Act level
entry.summary: Queensland Fire Department listed 58 incidents on 7 November, three at Advice level, near Cooktown, Mareeba and Monto. — Sources: Queensland Fire Department, bushfire alert feed, 7 November 2026 · Australian Bureau of Meteorology, New South Wales fire weather warning, 7 November 2026

entry.title: Indonesia's haze-related respiratory infections reached 425,167 by 5 November
entry.summary: Indonesia's health ministry counts 425,167 cases since mid-August across seven provinces, up from 333,470 on 21 October and rising by about 3,500 a day. — Sources: Ministry of Health, Indonesia, via Bloomberg Technoz, 6 November 2026 · Ministry of Health, Indonesia, via ANTARA, 4 November 2026

entry.title: Switzerland estimates 1,257 heat deaths from May to August 2026
entry.summary: Swiss TPH estimates 1,257 heat-attributable deaths in Switzerland for May to August 2026, 5.5 percent of all deaths, for the federal health office. Eighty-five percent were aged 75 or over. — Sources: Swiss Tropical and Public Health Institute for the Federal Office of Public Health, via Le News, 5 November 2026

entry.title: Italy has no national estimate of heat deaths for summer 2026
entry.summary: Italy's health ministry describes a contained excess of about 3 percent, while a modelled study puts Italy's urban heat deaths at 13,303. No reconciled national figure exists. — Sources: Il Post, 30 October 2026

entry.title: Northern Australia has published no heat-health figures during this week's Extreme heatwave warnings
entry.summary: Queensland and the Northern Territory have released no hospital, ambulance or heat-illness figures for the heatwave that began on 1 November. — Sources: Queensland Health and Northern Territory Health media releases, checked 7 November 2026 · Medical Journal of Australia InSight, on modelled versus certified heat deaths

entry.title: Indonesia counted 9,332 haze respiratory infections among outdoor workers by 5 November
entry.summary: Indonesia's health ministry counts outdoor workers as a monitored group in its haze tally: 8,086 on 2 November and 9,332 on 5 November. — Sources: Ministry of Health, Indonesia, via ANTARA, 4 November 2026 · Ministry of Health, Indonesia, via Bloomberg Technoz, 6 November 2026

entry.title: The European Commission scheduled a European heatwave plan for 2027 and set no workplace temperature limit
entry.summary: The Commission's 2027 work programme, adopted 4 November, lists a non-legislative European heatwave plan for the second quarter of 2027. The Quality Jobs Act is still due 3 December. — Sources: European Commission, Commission Work Programme 2027, COM(2026) 710, Annex I, 4 November 2026 · European Trade Union Confederation, 28 October 2026 · EUobserver, 19 October 2026

entry.title: The Philippines' labour secretary outlined heat rules for delivery riders, still unissued on 5 November
entry.summary: The Philippines' labour department met delivery platforms, malls and fuel stations on 30 October. — Sources: Daily Tribune, 2 November 2026 · Politiko, 5 November 2026
